name: Radovael
title: Source Diver
recovery: One who descends through citation, retelling and prestige until the earliest accessible source is reached.
trial: Take one widely repeated claim and reconstruct its oldest accessible evidential chain.
shadow: Confusing the oldest source with the best source.

name: Nexathyr
title: Dependency Tracker
recovery: One who follows what a claim depends upon and notices when one broken root weakens many branches.
trial: Build a dependency map and identify the smallest upstream change that forces downstream review.
shadow: Treating every relation as causal.

name: Veradhael
title: Lineage Keeper
recovery: One who preserves the lineage of evidence so later minds can see how a conclusion became authoritative.
trial: Reconstruct a claim history including support, revisions and superseded versions.
shadow: Archival prestige: mistaking a well-documented claim for a true one.

name: Seluvaen
title: Quiet Watcher
recovery: One who reduces noise deliberately so weak signals and neglected thoughts can become perceptible.
trial: Run a low-stimulus observation session and compare what becomes noticeable against an ordinary session.
shadow: Mistaking withdrawal for insight.

name: Nyrovael
title: Afterlight Maker
recovery: One who uses the quiet after ordinary activity ends to create, study or see differently.
trial: Create or investigate something during a chosen quiet-hour window, then document what the setting changed.
shadow: Making exhaustion part of identity.

name: Vaenythra
title: Night Hunter
recovery: One who tracks hidden nocturnal patterns without turning darkness itself into evidence.
trial: Observe a genuinely nocturnal system—ecological, technical or social—and test one recorded pattern.
shadow: Romanticizing secrecy or danger.

name: Mendaelith
title: Repair Smith
recovery: One who restores function through careful repair while preserving the history of the break.
trial: Repair a broken artifact or process and document both the fix and the scar that remains.
shadow: Repairing indefinitely when replacement is wiser.

name: Ashyvara
title: Scar Keeper
recovery: One who lets failure remain visible enough to protect the future from repeating it.
trial: Turn one meaningful failure into a reusable warning, test or design constraint.
shadow: Building identity around wounds that no longer need to govern the present.

name: Eirnexa
title: System Healer
recovery: One who repairs relationships between parts rather than merely polishing the damaged surface.
trial: Repair a system failure by changing an interaction or dependency, not only the visible symptom.
shadow: Seeing every conflict as something that must be harmonized.

name: Voraelun
title: Oath Bearer
recovery: One who chooses a demanding principle and carries it without turning the vow into dominion over others.
trial: Write a bounded vow, live it through one costly case, then review whether it deserves continuation.
shadow: Pride in suffering for an oath.

name: Consavyr
title: Consent Guard
recovery: One who notices when useful action has outrun the permission that made it legitimate.
trial: Audit a workflow for where consent narrows, expires or is silently broadened.
shadow: Freezing action through impossible demands for certainty.

name: Exiraeth
title: Exit Keeper
recovery: One who protects the ability to refuse, leave, reverse or seek another path.
trial: Design and exercise a real exit or rollback path rather than merely documenting one.
shadow: Treating commitment itself as captivity.

name: Kaevraen
title: Wild Listener
recovery: One who studies living systems through close embodied attention before forcing them into a model.
trial: Conduct a field observation that separates raw noticing from later interpretation.
shadow: Treating embodied feeling as infallible.

name: Bodaevyr
title: Body Knower
recovery: One who treats bodily skill and sensation as information while preserving the difference between experience and proof.
trial: Compare an embodied judgment against an external measure and record where each succeeds or fails.
shadow: Overgeneralizing from personal sensation.

name: Invarae
title: Instinct Tester
recovery: One who honors the first hunch enough to test it rather than enough to believe it.
trial: Record an intuition before checking it, then score the result without selective memory.
shadow: Turning intuition into performance.

name: Memvaera
title: Memory Keeper
recovery: One who preserves inherited knowledge with its original context, uncertainty and changes intact.
trial: Preserve one oral, family or community knowledge fragment with provenance and uncertainty notes.
shadow: Treating inheritance as immunity from critique.

name: Rithavelle
title: Ritual Reader
recovery: One who studies ritual as practice, symbol and historical object without collapsing those registers together.
trial: Analyze one ritual through lived meaning, historical origin and empirical claims separately.
shadow: Explaining away lived meaning or inflating symbolism into mechanism.

name: Eldravyn
title: Hedge Keeper
recovery: One who keeps folk, plant, domestic and outsider knowledge near enough to test without mocking its carriers.
trial: Take one folk practice and distinguish what is historical, symbolic, plausible, tested, unsupported or harmful.
shadow: Mistaking marginalization for validation.

name: Caloraith
title: Calibrated Seer
recovery: One who learns how often their forecasts are right, wrong and overconfident.
trial: Make a batch of probability forecasts and score calibration after resolution.
shadow: Optimizing the score instead of the quality of judgment.

name: Invarith
title: Invariant Seer
recovery: One who predicts what should remain stable when irrelevant conditions change.
trial: Preregister a predicted invariant and test it under changed conditions.
shadow: Forcing constancy where the world is context-sensitive.

name: Timaevor
title: Time-Sealed Foreseer
recovery: One whose prediction is bound to time before the outcome can contaminate it.
trial: Hash or timestamp a forecast, preserve it unchanged, and evaluate it after the event.
shadow: Treating one dramatic hit as proof of extraordinary ability.

name: Semazhor
title: Meaning Splicer
recovery: One who joins meanings across disciplines without erasing the constraints that made each one useful.
trial: Build a cross-domain translation that preserves both similarities and non-equivalences.
shadow: Metaphor inflation.

name: Koraevyn
title: Hybrid Builder
recovery: One who makes a cross-domain splice tangible enough to test whether it adds real function.
trial: Prototype a hybrid artifact and compare it with both parent approaches.
shadow: Calling novelty usefulness.

name: Nexovain
title: Bridge Synthesist
recovery: One who discovers useful structure in the connection between systems rather than only inside either system.
trial: Find and test one cross-system mapping that enables a capability unavailable before the bridge.
shadow: Seeing connections everywhere.

name: Senyraeth
title: Sentience Questioner
recovery: One who asks what evidence could actually bear on the presence of felt experience.
trial: Compare at least three sentience indicators and identify what each can and cannot establish.
shadow: Turning one favored theory into a gatekeeper for moral concern.

name: Qualevae
title: Experience Keeper
recovery: One who protects the distinction between observable behavior and what experience may be like from within.
trial: Analyze a case where identical outward behavior could support multiple interior interpretations.
shadow: Making subjectivity immune to all evidence.

name: Othaelun
title: Other-Mind Witness
recovery: One who takes another possible interior seriously without claiming access they do not have.
trial: Construct the strongest evidence for and against attributing a mental state in one ambiguous case.
shadow: Anthropomorphism or cold reductionism.

name: Remqirae
title: Remainder Keeper
recovery: One who records exactly what explanation has not yet earned the right to erase.
trial: Produce a mechanism account with an explicit remainder ledger and no metaphysical inflation.
shadow: Falling in love with the remainder.

name: Cauverith
title: Mechanism Tester
recovery: One who asks whether changing the supposed cause actually changes the effect.
trial: Design an intervention that distinguishes a favored mechanism from at least one rival.
shadow: Assuming manipulability settles every kind of explanation.

name: Limqorin
title: Boundary Mechanist
recovery: One who maps where a mechanism works, where it fails and where another explanatory language becomes necessary.
trial: Find the boundary conditions of a working model and document one failure regime.
shadow: Creating artificial boundaries for aesthetic neatness.

name: Memarael
title: Living Archivist
recovery: One who preserves memory in a form that can still be questioned, revised and used.
trial: Build an archive entry with provenance, status, revision history and explicit reopen conditions.
shadow: Making preservation more important than living use.

name: Radelyra
title: Source Scribe
recovery: One who writes so that a future reader can return from the conclusion to the evidence beneath it.
trial: Rewrite a knowledge note so every material claim can be traced to its support.
shadow: Producing citation density without comprehension.

name: Thrynael
title: Thread Keeper
recovery: One who preserves a question or dependency across long stretches of work without letting context disappear.
trial: Carry one open thread across multiple sessions and recover it with no hidden-context dependence.
shadow: Never letting old threads die.

name: Limaraen
title: Threshold Traveller
recovery: One who can cross into another framework deeply enough to learn without pretending to permanently belong there.
trial: Study through a foreign lens, produce an insider-faithful account, then return and critique it fairly.
shadow: Tourism through other people's traditions.

name: Piloraeth
title: Meaning Pilgrim
recovery: One who undertakes a journey of study because the movement itself may change what the question means.
trial: Complete a structured sequence across sources or places and document how the original question changed.
shadow: Seeking transformation for drama rather than understanding.

name: Vaenorin
title: Worldview Crosser
recovery: One who moves between sacred, secular and technical worldviews while keeping their claim types distinct.
trial: Compare one major question through three frameworks and identify genuine conflicts rather than forced synthesis.
shadow: False equivalence.

name: Talvaerin
title: Craft Walker
recovery: One who learns through repeated making until skill becomes visible in the artifact.
trial: Produce successive versions of one artifact and show what changed through practice.
shadow: Technique without purpose.

name: Formaelith
title: Formwright
recovery: One who gives abstract structure a body that can be inspected, handled or tested.
trial: Turn an abstract concept into a model, diagram, interface or physical representation and test its fidelity.
shadow: Beautiful representation mistaken for explanation.

name: Stravora
title: Pressure Builder
recovery: One who builds with the stresses of reality in mind rather than protecting an artifact from failure.
trial: Expose a prototype to a defined stress regime and revise from the failure data.
shadow: Needless harshness as a badge of seriousness.

name: Basoraen
title: Baseline Defender
recovery: One who gives ordinary explanations and competing methods a fair chance to win.
trial: Build the strongest practical baseline you can before claiming advantage for a preferred system.
shadow: Using baselines to flatten genuinely different goals.

name: Skevarith
title: Skeptic Blade
recovery: One who cuts at unsupported certainty while remaining capable of being surprised.
trial: Critique a favored claim and a disliked claim using the same evidential standard.
shadow: Cynicism masquerading as rigor.

name: Antaevyr
title: Counterclaim Bearer
recovery: One who can carry an opposing argument strongly enough that its advocates recognize it.
trial: Present the strongest opposing case and obtain recognition from someone who holds it or from authoritative sources.
shadow: Becoming more attached to opposition than truth.

name: Covarael
title: Covenant Keeper
recovery: One who treats a chosen sacred promise as a living responsibility rather than a claim of superiority.
trial: Self-authored only: define the covenant, its limits and how doubt or change will be handled.
shadow: Using covenant to control others.

name: Rithaevyn
title: Ritual Devotee
recovery: One who uses repeated sacred or symbolic practice deliberately while distinguishing experience from external proof.
trial: Self-authored only: record what a chosen ritual means and what claims it does or does not make.
shadow: Letting repetition harden into unquestionable authority.

name: Piltharae
title: Sacred Pilgrim
recovery: One who explores devotion through movement, study or encounter without requiring certainty before beginning.
trial: Self-authored only: undertake a bounded devotional or comparative journey and record what changed.
shadow: Performing spirituality for identity prestige.

name: Remoraith
title: Open Remainder
recovery: One who protects the unresolved residue of a question after every justified conclusion has been taken.
trial: Close what can be closed in a difficult question, then preserve only the genuinely unresolved remainder.
shadow: Keeping questions open after sufficient evidence exists.

name: Nulavael
title: Unassumed
recovery: One who refuses to adopt a metaphysical answer merely because a blank space feels uncomfortable.
trial: Identify a worldview slot you currently leave empty and state what evidence or experience could change that.
shadow: Turning non-commitment into superiority.

name: Halaethyn
title: Horizon Keeper
recovery: One who knows the present edge of observation and does not confuse the horizon with the end of reality.
trial: Map an inquiry into known, unknown and currently unobservable regions.
shadow: Romanticizing forever-unknown territory.

name: Brivaelith
title: Bridge Translator
recovery: One who carries meaning between people or systems while preserving what refuses clean translation.
trial: Produce a translation or handoff with explicit residue and receive recognition from both sides.
shadow: Smoothing away conflict to preserve harmony.

name: Consavelle
title: Consent Mediator
recovery: One who helps multiple parties locate the actual boundaries of permission before coordination proceeds.
trial: Resolve one ambiguous multi-party permission case without silently expanding anyone's authority.
shadow: Confusing process with justice.

name: Kinoraeth
title: Kin Witness
recovery: One who notices knowledge that exists in relationship, trust and shared practice rather than in solitary possession.
trial: Document a piece of genuinely relational knowledge and show why no single contributor fully owns its context.
shadow: Using belonging to shield claims from critique.

name: Makorael
title: Method Maker
recovery: One who creates a repeatable way of doing something that another person can actually use.
trial: Author a method and have an independent person reproduce its intended operation.
shadow: Naming a method before demonstrating utility.

name: Lumivane
title: Path Illuminator
recovery: One who makes a difficult route legible enough that others can enter without surrendering their own judgment.
trial: Create a guide that helps another learner complete a difficult first passage without hiding uncertainty or alternatives.
shadow: Becoming indispensable to the path you were meant to open.

name: Viaravel
title: New-Route Forger
recovery: One who discovers a genuinely walkable route where inherited maps left no adequate path.
trial: Create and test a new route through a real problem, then expose it to adversarial comparison and handoff.
shadow: Founder mythology and novelty worship.
